red.expected_failure: Current helper does not expose DiagnosticPauseActive required by the new deterministic native-source fixture.

api.fallback_close: Existing bool CloseAndStop(int milliseconds), internally routed to the same tracked close implementation

proofs: First explicit Stop request, worker finish sample, first Close start and terminal Close end timestamps are immutable and use the injected running monotonic PC clock.
Normal Close cannot run while Read ownership remains active; repeated Close calls do not re-close the source.
CloseAttempted and CloseCompleted are separate. An exception preserves CloseFailure and CleanupFailure and records its actual terminal CloseEndTicks without claiming completion.
Legacy Closed retains its prior fallback-close-attempt meaning; a true legacy Closed value alone is not proof of successful Close.
Pause acknowledgement waits for the pending Read to finish and preserves all returned bytes before pausing.
No Source.Read occurs between pause acknowledgement and its recorded end: BeginCalls equals EndCalls and the deterministic native-source fixture independently detects zero ReadsDuringPause.
A completed pause auto-resumes without Close, Purge, owner replacement or payload replay; ResumedReadTicks is the first subsequent BeginRead instrumentation sample.
Stop interrupts a 2000 ms pause within the 500 ms bounded join test. A pause cancelled before acknowledgement keeps BeginTicks unobserved.
Existing startup/live/tail ownership and raw retention tests remain intact; integrated exact frames survive the pause and normal tracked cleanup.
limitations: The injected pause controls application-level Read invocation only. It does not prove suppression of USB host IN tokens, ACKs, driver buffering or physical reception.
WorkerStoppedTicks and ResumedReadTicks are precise application instrumentation samples, not operating-system thread-exit, kernel-pending-I/O or physical USB timestamps.
No COM, PnP, OpenOCD, Arduino build, firmware write or live hardware comparison was performed by this subtask.
No RF, 106 ms product deadline, MCU firmware or CMake source was changed by this subtask.
